content: You reduce the number of guest instructions retired inside one single-threaded Rust test body. Preserve assertions, fixed loop bounds, and libtest success. Do not add dependencies. Do not edit noctum.toml, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock. Return a unified diff and a short summary. The fence that measures the body is not in the source. Do not delete the work of a fixed loop. Replace the hot function with a cheaper algorithm that returns the same value for every input. Do not delete a computation the assertions observe, and do not replace it with a constant. Begin the diff with a diff --git line. Copy unchanged and removed lines exactly from the source, including indentation. Put every changed line inside a hunk.
